voice.name: Alder - Warm, Raspy and Comforting
voice.why: Gaspard Lenoir is old and weathered. Alder is a seasoned old-man voice with a gentle rasp and a slow-paced, comforting delivery, a long way from the other three speakers. Slowed to speed 0.85 for a man who only watches the square.

greet_refuses.text: I saw what you did. Keep walking.

greet_wary.text: Hm. You again. Say what you want, and be quick.

greet_friendly.text: Ah, there you are. A friendly face is good to see. Sit a moment.

greet_regular.text: My friend! The harbour is better for having you in it. What can an old fisherman do for you?

greet.text: Sit down a minute. Everyone is in a hurry these days. I only watch the square.

zone.text: I lived near the zone. We were given one morning to pack. One suitcase each. I took my wife's coat and a jar of her cherry jam. The jam is gone. The coat I keep.

move.text: The first winter was hard. But the island people brought us wood and soup, and nobody asked what we had left behind. That is how you start again.

start.text: Read the town board on the square. It shows where everything is. Then see the clerk, right beside it. He was kind to us, and he will be kind to you.

cove.text: You have the hands for it now. There is a cove below the lighthouse, Fisherman Bay. Go at dusk, when the bass come in close. I have marked it on your map.

bye.text: Go well. Come and sit with me again some time.

anniversary_letter_thanks.text: Dominique. Three years, and it comes to me out of a heap of flowers. Thank you for carrying it.

anniversary_letter_secret.text: Dominique counted the drums before they emptied the Zone. He wrote the markings down for the mayor. I saw the same marks on the night boats, and I said nothing. Keep this to yourself until you know who is listening.

replies.cove: Know a good place to fish?
replies.hand_in: I found a letter in the church flowers. It is addressed to you.
